biomarkers.name: CDH1 (E-cadherin) loss
biomarkers.prevalence: >90% loss of membranous E-cadherin expression (defining feature)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark; distinguishes lobular from most ductal carcinomas. Germline CDH1 pathogenic variants cause hereditary diffuse gastric cancer syndrome and are associated with increased lobular breast cancer risk

biomarkers.name: HER2
biomarkers.prevalence: <5% in classic ILC (overall low; higher in pleomorphic variants)

biomarkers.name: PIK3CA
biomarkers.clinical_use: Alpelisib eligibility in HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic disease

biomarkers.name: ESR1 mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: Primarily acquired in metastatic ER-positive disease after aromatase inhibitor exposure; uncommon in treatment-naive primary ILC

biomarkers.name: ERBB2 mutations
biomarkers.prevalence: ~3–8% overall; enriched in metastatic and pleomorphic ILC
biomarkers.clinical_use: Potential eligibility for HER2-directed tyrosine kinase therapy in mutation-positive disease

biomarkers.name: ERBB3 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Recurrent ILC-associated alteration; no routine standard biomarker-directed use currently

biomarkers.name: PTEN alterations
biomarkers.clinical_use: May contribute to PI3K/AKT pathway-targeted therapy selection context

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small discohesive cells infiltrating in single-file 'Indian file' pattern with targetoid arrangement around ducts
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Modified Nottingham grade; classic ILC often grade 2 with low mitotic count, less often grade 1

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Typically 'immune-desert' or 'excluded' — less inflamed than IDC/NST even at similar stage
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrotic stroma; often minimal desmoplastic reaction; discohesive infiltration due to E-cadherin loss

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Luminal epithelial cells within the terminal duct lobular unit (TDLU), particularly lobular/acinar epithelium
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Luminal differentiation preserved (ER+, GATA3+, FOXA1+) but with characteristic E-cadherin loss producing discohesive single-file infiltration ('Indian file' pattern)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: CDH1 (E-cadherin) loss disrupts adherens junction cell-cell adhesion machinery — a defining feature that contributes to the distinct infiltrative phenotype and metastatic tropism
